adjudication.rationale: The new migration `db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb` builds an INSERT via string interpolation: `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, ...)"`. Here `h` is taken directly from the existing `site_settings` row `embeddable_hosts` (`val.split("\n")`). If any host line contains a single quote (or other SQL metacharacters), it will break SQL syntax and can inject SQL in the migration context. The diff shows no quoting/escaping (e.g., `quote(h)`), so this is a real correctness/security defect in the introduced code.
